text:
Claire Ng: Noticed an oddity: INV-2026-02555 applied 0% VAT even though customer country is DE (should be 19%). Ledger shows undercollection and we also auto-created a credit memo CM-2026-004 because tax delta was negative... Sam, can you check?
Owen Li: Invoice id? Were both invoice and credit memo emailed?
Claire Ng: INV-2026-02555, CM-2026-004. Generator payload: 
```json
{"id":"INV-2026-02555","customer":"Bauhaus GmbH","country":"DE","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Aug)","amount_cents":200000},{"desc":"tax","amount_cents":0}],"total_cents":200000}
```
and credit memo: 
```json
{"id":"CM-2026-004","related_invoice":"INV-2026-02555","lines":[{"desc":"tax adjustment","amount_cents":-38000}],"total_cents":-38000}
```
Billing Bot: tax-service: calculation returned rate=0 for country=DE at 2026-08-03T05:11:02Z error="lookup-miss:tax-rates" job=tax-20260803-11
Samantha Voss: That looks like tax-rate cache miss during the nightly run. There was a rollout earlier that warmed a new tax table. Might be a migrating index. Were retries involved?
Billing Bot: billing-generator: WARNING idempotency key missing; retried invoice generation created credit memo CM-2026-004 because delta < 0 job=bgen-20260803-12
Owen Li: Immediate actions: hold outgoing emails, patch ledger to reflect correct tax, void/adjust credit memo if it shouldn't exist, and add a guard in generator to fail if tax lookup returns 0 for countries with VAT. Finance lead approval required to mutate ledger.
Claire Ng: Approve adjustments. Proceed. :white_check_mark:
Samantha Voss: Steps executed: 
```
# pause tax-refresh worker
opsctl worker pause tax-rate-refresh
# reconcile invoice tax
tax-cli invoice adjust-tax --id INV-2026-02555 --rate 19 --force
# void incorrect credit memo
billing-cli credit void --id CM-2026-004 --reason "auto-created on tax lookup miss" --force
# regenerate invoice
billing-cli invoice regenerate --id INV-2026-02555 --force
```
Billing Bot: adjust-tax output: {"id":"INV-2026-02555","old_tax_cents":0,"new_tax_cents":38000,"new_total_cents":238000}
Billing Bot: void output: {"id":"CM-2026-004","status":"voided"}
Billing Bot: regen output: {"id":"INV-2026-02555","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Aug)","amount_cents":200000},{"desc":"tax","amount_cents":38000}],"total_cents":238000}
Tax Ops: Filed ENG-5710: "Tax-rate cache migration leads to 0% VAT on EU invoices -> incorrect credit memos" with logs and mitigation: atomic tax-rate publish or generator fallback. Assigned to eng-billing and eng-tax, priority=P1.
Owen Li: Notifying support to withhold any customer notices and mark ticket for audit. Closing thread unless disputes show up.
